Esta é uma vaga exclusiva para o
Aeroporto do Galeão (GIG)
Responsabilidades e atribuições

Possuímos várias posições disponíveis com foco operacional, as principais sendo:

  • Auxiliar de Rampa

As atividades consistem na movimentação de bagagens da esteira para equipamentos de transporte, calçamento, carregamento e descarregamento de aeronaves com malas e cargas, sinalização em torno do voo a ser atendido, inspeção e varredura do piso para coleta de objetos caídos. Dentre os equipamentos e mobiliários utilizados destacam-se telefone e rádio de comunicação. O setor encontra-se no subsolo, com acesso do colaborador ao posto de trabalho por elevadores e escadas rolantes e deslocamento pelas áreas operacionais do aeroporto.

Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e dos inferiores, postura em bipedestação para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, rotação e flexão do tronco, esforço físico e deambulação por toda área operacional.

Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para movimentação de bagagens da esteira para equipamentos de transporte, calçamento, carregamento e descarregamento de aeronaves com malas e cargas, sinalização em torno do voo a ser atendido, inspeção e varredura do piso para coleta de objetos caídos, percepção auditiva para identificação de sinais sonoros de equipamentos e máquinas na pista.

Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.

  • Auxiliar de Serviços Gerais (Limpeza)

As atividades consistem na organização da bolsa de suprimentos, aguardo da liberação de limpeza pela tripulação, acoplamento da escada na aeronave, coleta dos sacos de lixos, reposição dos suprimentos, aspiração do carpete, verificação da presença de objetos e higienização das poltronas e de bolsões, preenchimento de documentação do voo e limpeza das salas administrativas. Dentre os equipamentos utilizados destacam-se telefone, aspirador, panos, sacos de lixo, lixeira e bolsa de suprimentos. O setor encontra-se no subsolo, com acesso do colaborador ao posto de trabalho por elevadores e escadas rolantes e deslocamento pelas áreas operacionais do aeroporto.

Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e dos inferiores, postura em bipedestação para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, deambulação por toda extensão do aeroporto para o atendimento do voo, rotação e flexão do tronco e esforço físico para limpeza e deslocamento da escada da aeronave.

Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para inspeções e limpezas e percepção auditiva para atendimento telefônico e detecção de sinais sonoros emergenciais em áreas operacionais.

Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação de dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.

  • Auxiliar Administrativo (Operações)

As atividades consistem na gestão do faturamento e conciliação documental diária dos voos realizados, encaminhamento para departamento financeiro, elaboração de relatórios, lançamento de dados no sistema, arquivo, leitura e envio de e-mail. Dentre os equipamentos e mobiliários utilizados destacam-se cadeira, mesa, arquivos, microcomputador, impressora com 1,28m de altura do piso e telefone. O setor encontra-se no piso térreo, com deslocamento do colaborador pelas áreas administrativas e operacionais do aeroporto por meio de elevadores e escadas rolantes.

Nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e inferiores, postura variável para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, eventualmente existe a necessidade de esforço físico e deambulação entre áreas administrativas e operacionais do aeroporto.

Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para elaboração de relatórios, leitura e elaboração de e-mails, faturamento, lançamento de dados no sistema, e percepção auditiva para atendimento telefônico e aos colaboradores, visitantes e clientes.

Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.

title: Global Analysis Engineer
description:
Do you enjoy being part of a successful team?
Would you like to work on industry leading projects?
Join our Team
Bringing cutting-edge physical and digital technologies together to create oilfield equipment is the beating heart of our work. Devising smarter systems that control and monitor oil and gas extraction, our subsea and flexible pipe capabilities are industry leading. Our team provides support for customer operations to ensure continuity for production.
Partner with the best
Systems engineering is a cross-functional engineering discipline centered on an approach, mindset, and process. All activities that consider both the business and the technical needs of the customers with the goal of providing a quality product that meets the user's needs. The discipline that executes a robust process of design, creation, and optimization of systems, consisting of identification and quantification of system requirements, creation of alternate system design concepts, performance of design trade studies, selection and implementation of the best designs and verification that the design is properly integrated and executed. Process that proceeds from concept to production to operation.
As a GLOBAL ANALYSIS ENGINEER, you will be responsible for:
Responsible for the dynamic modeling and analysis of flexible riser systems to meet Client specifications and industry standards.
Assessing environmental and vessel data for implementation into a system model.
Providing detailed technical evaluations of riser systems as part of the project execution process.
Supporting development of methodologies and produce procedures for riser system analysis.
Reviewing, assessing and presenting design documentation results (Metocean Data, mooring reports…).
Producing comprehensive analysis reports for submission as part of either FEED study or Project Execution work.
Interfacing with the engineering groups both internally and externally on the analysis outputs for the design of the riser system and ancillary equipment, to present a comprehensive technical package.
Attending client meetings in relation to the work performed.
Ensuring that the applicable engineering aspects of the design, quality and safety requirements are implemented in accordance with BH and statutory requirements.
Producing engineering procedures and calculation sheets to further improve BH's methodologies and technical capabilities.
Providing technical support to the Sales and Tendering Group as required in conducting system level analysis.
Must be able to demonstrate performance in accomplishment of assigned technical programs on a sustained basis either as an individual or member of a technical team.
Must be able to contribute to technical improvements through tools development or automation of analysis/procedures.
Fuel your passion
To be successful in this role you will:
Hold a degree in Mechanical, Naval Architecture, Civil, Petroleum or related disciplines.
Hold active CREA.
Have advanced English.

Have good written and spoken communication, proven analytical and organizational ability.

Formação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou área relacionada;

Em nossa Visão, assumimos o compromisso de ser a primeira escolha dos colaboradores e de crescer de forma arrojada, sinérgica e sustentável.
Nesse desafio, buscamos promover e manter um alto nível de engajamento de equipe.

Recolhimento do Lixo, Corpo de Bombeiros, PAM, Polícia Federal, Receita Federal;
Controlar a entrada e saída de veículos do terminal pela portaria principal (caminhões de transporte
de resíduos);
Realizar vistorias físicas, de materiais e equipamentos, nos veículos que desejam acessar pelas
portarias;.
Orientar/ Monitorar usuários no treinamento/integração rápida realizada na portaria principal.
Recolher crachás nos cofres das cancelas das portarias;
Arquivar (arquivo morto patrimonial) os documentos ref. aos processos de Segurança Patrimonial
Aplicar e promover Programa Parceiro Patrimonial, junto aos companheiros de trabalho, funcionários
Tecon e terceiros que atuam no terminal;
Preencher formulário de liberação de saída e receber/protocolar cartas (receita federal polícia federal)
de acessos a área operacional e a navios.
Manter atualizado o quadro de assinaturas de liberações e cadastros de terceiros cfe as normas de
segurança patrimonial;
Conhecer riscos gerados pelas suas atividades e zelar pelas normas de SMS, sendo um aliado na
disseminação de informações, contribuindo para a promoção da conscientização e proteção dos
clientes internos e externos em acidentes de trabalho, doenças ocupacionais e preservação ambiental.

Ensino Médio Completo;
Conhecimento em Pacote Office;
Noções de funcionamento de terminal portuário.

Juntos transformamos realidades.
Somos a Wilson Sons, o maior operador de logística marítima e portuária do mercado brasileiro, com mais de 187 anos de experiência. Oferecemos soluções completas para mais de 5 mil clientes, incluindo armadores, importadores e exportadores, indústria de energia offshore, projetos de energia renovável e setor do agronegócio. Nossa longevidade é fruto da incansável busca por ampliar horizontes, explorar novos caminhos e criar conexões para o futuro. Por isso, lideramos a inovação em nosso setor para ir cada vez mais longe e compartilhar o crescimento com todos que fazem parte dessa jornada.

Estamos em constante movimento para entregar o nosso melhor e ser referência. Aqui, valorizamos o trabalho bem feito, o que se reflete na excelência das soluções que desenvolvemos. title: Analista de Conteúdo
description:
Aqui no LIV, entendemos que os sentimentos são partes essenciais para a aprendizagem, por isso, a nossa missão é criar espaços de escuta e fala que ampliem a compreensão de si, do outro e do mundo, promovendo um aprendizado socioemocional de qualidade para todos. Para isso, buscamos pessoas que se identifiquem com o nosso propósito e compartilhem da nossa vontade de espalhar o Jeito LIV, impactando as comunidades escolares de todo o Brasil.

Estamos em busca de um Analista de Conteúdo que seja proativo(a), criativo(a), que goste de trabalhar em equipe, ame educação e tenha facilidade de escrita para ser parte da equipe de desenvolvimento de criação de conteúdo pedagógico e material didático do LIV

E aí, #VemSerLIVástico com a gente?

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Revisão do material escrito visando melhor impactar o nosso público a partir de pesquisa e feedback;
  • Participar de reuniões de equipe e de criação de projetos;
  • Realizar pesquisas com professores, alunos e gestores;
  • Acompanhar palestras e formações;
  • Conduzir dinâmicas com equipes internas e externas.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Graduação em psicologia, pedagogia, licenciaturas ou demais graduações ligadas a área da Educação;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar 40 horas semanais (contratação CLT), no modelo híbrido (nosso escritório fica em Botafogo, no Rio de Janeiro);
  • Ter facilidade para produzir textos que dialogue com diversos públicos (alunos, professores e gestores);
  • Ser criativo na elaboração de dinâmicas e atividades do universo de Educação Socioemocional;
  • Ser responsável no cumprimento de prazos e processos burocráticos da empresa;
  • Ser colaborativo e disponível para aprendizagem.

Não é essencial, mas vamos amar se você tiver:

  • Alguma especialização ou experiência na área de Educação/Psicologia/Educação Midiática;
  • Experiência na elaboração de material didático;
  • Familiaridade com dados e/ou processos de pesquisa;
  • Experiência em sala de aula.

Informações adicionais

Acreditamos que um time diverso é o caminho para cumprir a nossa missão de transformar vidas e o Brasil. Assim, incentivamos a candidatura de pessoas que se identifiquem com grupos minorizados em todas as nossas posições.

Não podemos escolher o que sentimos, mas podemos aprender o que fazer com nossos sentimentos. Já pensou nisso?

Prazer, somos o Laboratório Inteligência de Vida, mas pode chamar de LIV Entendemos que os sentimentos são partes essenciais para a aprendizagem, por isso, a nossa missão é criar espaços de escuta e fala que ampliem a compreensão de si, do outro e do mundo, promovendo um aprendizado socioemocional de qualidade para todos.

Para isso, buscamos pessoas que se identifiquem com o nosso propósito e compartilhem da nossa vontade de espalhar o jeito LIV, impactando as comunidades escolares de todo o Brasil.

Vem com a gente nessa jornada?

Aqui você vai encontrar:

Pessoas colaborativas - Acreditamos que juntos somos capazes de encontrar as melhores soluções;

Crescimento com responsabilidade e propósito - Reconhecemos que a ética e o impacto pedagógico são inegociáveis no nosso dia a dia;

Cuidado e escuta com quem faz o LIV - Valorizamos o cuidado e o respeito como partes imprescindíveis do nosso trabalho, por isso somos empáticos e acolhedores;

Visão em movimento - Somos inquietos, propositivos e inovamos para entregar a melhor experiência socioemocional;

Compromisso com a nossa comunidade - Tomamos decisões a partir do que as nossas escolas têm a dizer, praticando a escuta ativa e a cultura de feedbacks.

description:

Join our Subsea & Surface Pressure Systems Team
Baker Hughes is the leading energy technology company, who delivers across the energy value chain through our market-leading business segments. We invest in the health and well-being of our workforce, train and reward talent and develop leaders at all levels to bring out the best in each other.

title: Gender and Urban Safety Consultant
description:
Result of Service

The Gender and Urban Safety Consultant reports to the Head of Brazil Office. He/She shall duly and timely perform his/her obligations, under this Terms of Reference. The Consultant will work in close collaboration with the UN-Habitat's operational and technical teams.

Work Location

Home based

Expected duration

Two (2) months

Duties and Responsibilities

Background The main mandate of the United Nations Human Settlements Programme (UN-Habitat) is to promote sustainable development of human settlements and policies conducive to adequate housing for all. Within this framework, UN-Habitat supports central and state governments, as well as local authorities and other partners for the implementation of the Habitat Agenda, the 2030 Agenda with the Sustainable Development Goals and the New Urban Agenda. UN-Habitat helps the urban poor by transforming cities into safer, more inclusive, compact, integrated, resilient and connected places with better opportunities where everyone can live with dignity. It works with organizations at every level, including all spheres of government, civil society, and the private sector to help build, manage, plan and finance sustainable urban development. The Regional Office for Latin American and the Caribbean – ROLAC – is based in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The Agency puts emphasis in developing and managing activities in the host country. Indeed, for the past years, UN-Habitat has expanded its portfolio in Brazil by working with the three tiers of government to support the formulation and implementation of more effective, sustainable, participative, and socially fairer urban economic, social, and environmental policies. Since 2017, the project Urban, Sustainable, and Inclusive Prosperity in the State of Alagoas – An Integrated Initiative (known as "Visão Alagoas 2030"), a partnership between the State Government and UN-Habitat, has strengthened institutional capacity to plan and implement state public policies aimed at sustainable urban development. Among the initiatives to be implemented, the project will provide specialized technical assistance to strengthen the Policy to Address Domestic and Family Violence against Women ("Alagoas Lilás", in Portuguese), a permanent and intersectoral state public policy established in 2025, aimed at addressing violence against women in the state of Alagoas. The policy is coordinated by the State Secretariat for Women and implemented in an integrated and coordinated manner by state secretariats responsible for carrying out a set of actions. Within this framework, the State Secretariat for Education is responsible for: (i) incorporating themes related to gender equality and violence prevention into teacher training programs and the curriculum of the state public education system; (ii) carrying out educational campaigns in public schools; and (iii) developing educational materials and pedagogical projects with a focus on gender and human rights. In this context, as a means of strengthening the implementation of the Alagoas Lilás policy in state schools, the project will deliver a training course on gender, urban violence prevention, and the safe use of public spaces, targeting the technical teams of the state secretariats involved in the policy, with particular emphasis on the teaching staff of the State Secretariat for Education. The main objective of the training course is to strengthen conceptual and applied understanding of gender, the right to the city, and violence prevention, contributing to the identification of inequalities and situations of gender-based violence in urban and educational contexts, as well as to the incorporation of preventive and inclusive approaches into public policies and pedagogical practices. The course shall address, among other topics: (i) conceptual alignment on gender, gender-based violence, and the right to the city; (ii) strategies and public policies aimed at preventing gender-based violence; (iii) gender-sensitive urban planning and urban and environmental factors associated with perceptions of (in)security; and (iv) the role of schools in preventing multiple forms of violence, with a focus on urban safety and the home–school commute. Other topics related to the central theme may be incorporated into the course syllabus as necessary to achieve the proposed objectives. The course shall also ensure conceptual alignment with the guidelines of the Sustainable Development Goals, the New Urban Agenda, and the objectives of the Alagoas Lilás policy. The course will be delivered in-person in Maceió, with a total workload of eight (8) hours, conducted over a full day (morning and afternoon). Approximately 60 participants are expected, including representatives from the State Secretariat for Women, the State Secretariat for Education, the Steering Committee of the Alagoas Lilás policy, and other state secretariats related to the thematic area. At the end of the training, participants are expected to have the potential to act as multipliers of the references, methodologies, and good practices shared, contributing to the strengthening of state initiatives aimed at addressing multiple forms of violence in the state of Alagoas. In addition to the training materials, to be provided in slide presentation format during the course, a toolkit shall be developed to support the dissemination and adaptation of the content in state public schools and other state-level initiatives related to the theme. The toolkit shall include a set of technical and pedagogical materials, such as key concepts, reference guides and methodologies, practical examples, and guidance on the dissemination and adaptation of the approaches addressed throughout the training. Following the completion of the course, an activity report shall be prepared, including a systematization of the content and agenda, the methodology adopted, the dynamics applied, the profile of participants, the results of self-assessment instruments, and the lessons learned throughout the activity. To properly implement this initiative, a Gender and Urban Safety Consultant is required to design and deliver the course, ensuring the technical quality of the content, the pedagogical coherence of the training, and the integration of gender, urban safety, and right-to-the-city approaches. Report to UN-Habitat Manager The Gender and Urban Safety Consultant reports to the Head of Brazil Office, who will evaluate him/her. Responsibilities The Gender and Urban Safety Consultant will support the implementation of the project, and its activities, with the following responsibilities: a) Develop the training materials, in slide presentation format, covering the objectives, agenda, methodology to be adopted, contents to be addressed, as well as the practical and interactive activities to be applied, among other aspects necessary for the proper delivery of the course. b) Prepare technical support materials for the training, containing key concepts related to the subject matter presented in a glossary format, as well as a compilation of practical guides, methodologies, national and international good practices, and other relevant reference documents. c) Design and deliver the training course, in coordination with the UN-Habitat team and the Government of the State of Alagoas. d) Ensure the integration of theoretical and practical content related to gender, the right to the city, and violence prevention, promoting applied reflections within urban, educational, and public management contexts. e) Systematize the results of the training course, including a description of the content and agenda, the methodology adopted, the dynamics applied, the profile of participants, the results of self-assessment instruments, and the lessons learned throughout the activity, in accordance with the template to be provided by the UN-Habitat team. f) Ensure the adoption of ethical principles in the delivery of the training, particularly regarding active listening, respect for diversity, and the promotion of a safe, inclusive, and participatory learning environment. g) Participate in alignment, monitoring, and technical validation meetings with the UN-Habitat team and the Government of the State of Alagoas. h) Develop reports following ABNT guidelines, ensuring alignment with UN-Habitat's quality standards and project requirements. The Consultant will be responsible for completing all courses and training activities that are indicated to him/her by his/her supervisor. The security course BSAFE, from UNDSS, is required to be accredited during the first month of employment. The Consultant will be responsible for his/her own security, so the person should get familiarized with United Nations security mechanisms and comply with them according to the Framework of Accountability for the United Nations Security Management System. Outputs/Work Assignment The Gender and Urban Safety Consultant shall assist in the implementation of the project, according to the stated responsibilities and the delivery of the following products: Product 1 – Capacity-Building Training Package on Gender and Urban Violence Prevention Description: The training materials, in slide presentation format (Canva or Power Point), shall cover the objectives, agenda, methodology to be adopted, contents to be addressed, as well as the practical and interactive activities to be applied, among other aspects necessary for the proper delivery of the course. In addition to the course teaching materials, a document in Word format, between 15 and 25 pages, shall be prepared, including key concepts related to the subject matter in a glossary format and a compilation of practical guides, methodologies, national and international good practices, as well as other reference documents. This material will be used to compose the toolkit to be organized by the UN-Habitat team and made available to participants after the completion of the course. Expected delivery date: 20 days after signing the contract. Product 2 – Activity Report of the training on gender, urban violence prevention, and the safe use of public spaces Description: The Activity Report shall be prepared after the completion of the course and shall include a systematization of the course content and agenda, the adopted methodology, the applied activities and dynamics, the participants profile, the results of the self-assessment instruments, and the lessons learned throughout the activity, in accordance with the template provided by the UN-Habitat team. Expected delivery date: 45 days after signing the contract.

Qualifications/special skills

Education Required:
• Postgraduate degree (Latu Sensu or Stricto Sensu) in Urban Planning, Architecture and Urbanism, Social Science, Political Science, Law, International Relations, or related fields is required, or additional four (4) years of relevant experience to the post, beyond the requirement.
• Bachelor's degree in Social Science, Political Science, Law, International Relations, Architecture and Urbanism or related fields. Work experience:
• Minimum six (6) years of professional and/or academic experience in gender and ur-ban safety in Brazil is required.
• Good knowledge of international, national, and subnational good practices in gender-responsive urban planning is desirable.
• Experience in capacity building and training of multidisciplinary teams in the public sec-tor is desirable.
• Previous experience within the UN system is desirable. Skills:
• Strong capacity to deliver training for education professionals and/or public sector programmatic staff is required.
• Ability to conduct theoretical and practical activities using agile methodologies and inclusive, participatory approaches is desirable.
• Excellent written and spoken Portuguese is required.
• Good command of technological tools, such as Microsoft Windows and Microsoft Office, is required. Competencies
• Professionalism: Experience working in an inter-institutional environment, project management, monitoring-evaluation; approaches and strategies regarding good urban governance and local and regional development.
• Planning and organization: Professional approach to work, strong sense of responsibility, operate with minimal supervision; proven organizational skills and ability to manage a workload efficiently and within set deadlines.
• Communication: Ability to write clearly and effectively; listen to others, interpret messages correctly and respond appropriately; show openness in information sharing and keep everyone informed; solid abstract reasoning skills together with a proven capacity to write documents for diverse audiences.
• Teamwork: Ability to work with teams, demonstrate leadership, conflict management and consensus facilitation skills; ability to work in a multicultural and multi-ethnic environment, and to respect diversity; sensitivity to the main streaming of vulnerability; willingness and ability to work in difficult environments. Knowledge Management
• The person must know the processes, procedures, and norms of UN-Habitat, to guarantee an adequate quality of the activities described above, following the standards of the organization.
• The person will propose formats and procedures that allow the efficient implementation of the activities related to the project development.
• The person must know the file of the Office, work with it, and ensure its proper maintenance, accessibility for all staff, and due updating.
• The person will prepare databases related to the project running.
• The person will make sure that all relevant technical information will be adequately shared with the correspondent staff.
• The person will ensure that all produced material will be fit-for-purpose and delivered, in an organized way, for posterior consultation and use of the Agency.
• The person will only share the information produced with the team agency, assuring the privacy of the content.

Languages


• English and French are the working languages of the United Nations Secretariat, and Spanish is the working language of the Regional Office.
• For the post advertised, fluency in Portuguese is required.

Additional Information

Travel details: The Consultant must be available to travel to the places related to the activities in the country, if requested by the Head of Brazil Office. Missions will be coordinated and financed by UN-Habitat, according to the United Nations travel rules and guidelines. title: Business Development Manager
description:
medtechrec is partnered with a growing, privately held global medical device organisation specialising in sports medicine to recruit a Business Development Manager to support continued expansion across Brazil.

The organisation operates internationally and combines strong commercial growth with a collaborative, people-led culture. This role sits at the centre of the regional commercial strategy and plays a critical part in supporting clinicians, partners, and internal stakeholders.

Position Overview


The Business Development Manager acts as the key link between the companys product portfolio, its commercial partners, and the clinical community. As the regional subject-matter expert, the role combines deep product knowledge, market intelligence, and partner enablement to ensure solutions are clearly understood, effectively positioned, and confidently adopted.

Working closely with the Business Development Manager, the Product Specialist supports regional sales strategy through technical expertise, pricing insight, and strong relationship management.

Key Responsibilities


Product Expertise & Market Insight

  • Serve as the regional product expert, maintaining in-depth knowledge of product features, clinical applications, and supporting evidence.
  • Monitor competitive activity and market trends to support pricing strategy and commercial decision-making.
  • Provide data-driven insights to the Business Development Manager on pricing opportunities and challenges.

Partner & Customer Enablement

  • Support distributor partners in developing and executing effective go-to-market strategies.
  • Deliver structured product training and technical presentations to partners, clinicians, and internal teams.
  • Act as the first point of contact for complex clinical or technical product enquiries.

Relationship Management

  • Build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with distributors, partners, and end-user clinicians.
  • Represent the organisation professionally in the field, acting as a consistent brand ambassador.

Sales & Strategic Support

  • Collaborate closely with the Business Development Manager to support regional sales planning and execution.
  • Provide technical and clinical support throughout the sales cycle to progress commercial opportunities.
  • Prepare technical documentation and support responses for tenders.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Marketing to support the development of sales tools, campaigns, and educational materials.
  • Partner with Product Management to relay structured field insights that inform future product development.
  • Ensure effective communication of market and customer feedback to internal stakeholders.

Candidate Profile

  • Bachelors degree in Business, Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum of 3 years experience in a Product Specialist, clinical support, or similar role within sports medicine.
  • Strong ability to communicate complex technical or clinical information clearly and persuasively.
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to translate market data into actionable insights.
  • Proactive, organised, and comfortable operating autonomously in a field-based role.
  • Fluent in Portuguese; English proficiency is a strong advantage.

Whats on Offer

  • Competitive salary with performance-based bonus.
  • Opportunity to play a pivotal role in a high-growth international medical device organisation.
  • Supportive, collaborative working environment.
  • Clear scope for professional development and long-term career progression.

description:

At Alignerr, we partner with the world's leading AI research teams and labs to build and train cutting-edge AI models.
We're focused on the security of AI systems themselves, examining how modern models can be attacked, misused, or pushed beyond their intended boundaries. You will work with realistic scenarios to help ensure AI systems remain safe, reliable, and aligned with security best practices.

Background in security with a strong interest in how AI systems are built and deployed

Assessoramento técnico e análises no registro e acompanhamento das licenças, autorizações e condicionantes ambientais no sistema LA+, ou equivalente;
Atuação nos processos de obtenção de licenças ambientais e autorizações ambientais que se fizerem necessárias para Implementação do empreendimento junto aos Órgãos Ambientais pertinentes;

Realização de Auditoria Comportamental, de forma alinhada ao procedimento interno.

Na Capco promovemos uma cultura inclusiva. Valorizamos a diversidade em todas as suas expressões.

Sobre a BigDataCorp

A BigDataCorp é a maior datatech da América Latina, e democratiza, desde 2013, o acesso aos dados, aumentando possibilidades e certezas em um mundo repleto de incertezas.

Somos pioneiros na captura, estruturação, armazenamento e distribuição de dados no Brasil. Nosso processo é único. Já nascemos adequados à LGPD e às demais regulamentações, garantindo a origem das informações fornecidas, obtidas sempre de forma ética.

A BigDataCorp tem a missão de democratizar o acesso aos dados. Nós temos sede por crescimento e inovação, e queremos ser a maior datatechplataforma de dados do mundo.  Estamos sempre em evolução e crescimento, por isso, novas posições dentro da BigDataCorp são constantemente necessárias. 

Criamos o Banco de Talentos para acelerar o processo de recrutamento e seleção, trazendo maior transparência para os candidatos, e mais agilidade para o time interno trabalhando com este processo. Se você curtiu e se identificou com a nossa empresa, inscreva-se em nosso Banco de Talentos Seja a primeira pessoa a ser considerada para oportunidades na BDC.

O time de Infraestrutura é responsável por organizar, manter e evoluir as diferentes plataformas que constituem a base da operação da empresa. Da organização dos serviços de computação na nuvem à segurança da informação. Estamos à procura de um Especialista DevOps apaixonado por tecnologia para integrar a nossa equipe de TI. Se você é especialista em implementar, gerenciar e aprimorar práticas de DevOps, contribuindo para a entrega contínua de software e eficiência operacional, queremos te conhecer. 

Requirements

O que vai fazer no dia a dia

  • Configurar e gerenciar ambientes de infraestrutura na AWS, com foco em AWS ECS e AWS EKS;
  • Desenvolver e manter infraestrutura como código (laC) usando Terraform;
  • Implementar e gerenciar pipelines de integração contínua/entrega contínua (CI/CD) no Gitlab;
  • Realizar monitoramento, escalabilidade e automação de processos de implantação;
  • Garantir a segurança e a conformidade das práticas de DevOps;
  • Colaborar com equipes de desenvolvimento e operações para otimizar a entrega de software;

  • Participar na configuração e gerenciamento de recursos em ambientes AWS;
  • Organizations, AWS Control Tower e AWS IAM Identity Center.

Habilidades necessárias

  • Experiência comprovada como DevOps em um ambiente de TI, com ênfase em AWS ECS e AWS EKS;
  • Proficiência em Terraform para laC;
  • Experiência em configuração de pipelines de CI/CD usando Gitlab;
  • Conhecimento sólido em monitoramento e soluções de automação;
  • Familiaridade com integração das pipelines com ferramentas de análise de código e segurança, como, por exemplo, Sonarqube e ZapProxy;
  • Habilidades de comunicação eficazes e capacidade de trabalho em equipe.

Será um diferencial

  • Certificações relevantes da AWS.

Buscamos um profissional que vai gerir as seguintes atividades:


• Gerir a carteira de clientes com postura de um executivo de contas sênior — conduzindo reuniões, alinhando expectativas, estruturando briefings claros e coordenando todas as entregas com foco em resultado e relacionamento.


• Coordenar todo o ciclo de vida dos projetos, desde a entrada do pedido até o embarque, passando por desenvolvimento de embalagem, validações com a fábrica, controle de cronogramas, pagamentos, registro sanitário e follow-up contínuo com os clientes.


• Liderar as interfaces internas com as áreas de Supply Chain, Produção, P&D, Qualidade, Regulatório, Logística e Financeiro, garantindo que todos os departamentos estejam alinhados com os objetivos de cada projeto, servindo como PMO de todos os projetos de sua área.


• Ser o ponto focal dos clientes internacionais da linha, garantindo comunicação fluida, antecipação de riscos, resolução ágil de problemas e construção de relacionamentos de longo prazo baseados em confiança e performance.


• Acompanhar prazos de produção, emissão de documentos e embarques com os times de exportação, despachantes e agentes de carga, assegurando o cumprimento de prazos e a satisfação do cliente.


• Apoiar a Coordenação da area nas decisões estratégicas, fornecendo dados atualizados, relatórios, histórico de negociações e acompanhamento de KPIs.


• Acompanhar status de contratos, pagamentos, aprovações de layout, documentos regulatórios e demais etapas críticas de cada projeto, garantindo rastreabilidade, organização e conformidade com os requisitos dos países de destino.


• Formação Superior completa;


• Inglês intermediario;


• Experiência anterior em atendimento a clientes B2B e/ou gestão de projetos.


• Experiência em comércio exterior, supply chain, branding ou indústria são diferenciais.


• Perfil multitarefa, resiliente, orientado a prazos e extremamente organizado.


• Perfil com grande ambição;

About Foundey
Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States.
We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences.
With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.
The Opportunity
We are looking for a highly experienced and strategic Product Designer.
This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.
The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.
Responsibilities
Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.
Requirements
Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.
Preferred Qualifications
5+ years of experience as a Product Designer
Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.
Why Join Us?
At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide.
You'll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.
How to Apply
If you're a product designer with a passion for solving complex problems in the cybersecurity and SaaS space, we'd love to hear from you.

title: SEO Outreach Manager
description:
At BairesDev, we've been leading the way in technology projects for over 15 years. We deliver cutting-edge solutions to giants like Google and the most innovative startups in Silicon Valley.
Our diverse 4,000+ team, composed of the world's Top 1% of tech talent, works remotely on roles that drive significant impact worldwide.
When you apply for this position, you're taking the first step in a process that goes beyond the ordinary. We aim to align your passions and skills with our vacancies, setting you on a path to exceptional career development and success.
SEO Outreach Manager at BairesDev
In this role, you'll own the entire outreach function: from strategy development to execution and performance optimization. You'll identify target websites, craft compelling outreach campaigns, and build genuine relationships with webmasters, journalists, and content managers. As the team grows, you'll also be responsible for building and managing outreach specialists. Success means consistently hitting monthly link acquisition targets while improving response rates and refining our outreach processes over time.
What You'll Do:
- Manage outreach operations and reporting, mentor outreach specialists, maintain organized outreach pipelines, document processes, and provide regular performance updates to leadership.
- Create and execute compelling outreach campaigns, crafting personalized, persuasive messages to journalists, website owners, and bloggers via email, contact forms, or social media that drive responses and link placements.
- Identify high-quality link opportunities by researching and qualifying authoritative blogs, websites, and publications to target through manual outreach processes.
- Analyze and optimize outreach performance by tracking success metrics such as response rates, bounce rates, and link acquisition, analyzing competitors' backlink profiles, and continuously testing new strategies to improve results.
- Identify unlinked mentions and broken link opportunities, proactively finding and capitalizing on existing brand mentions and broken link building opportunities.
What we are looking for:
- Experience in email outreach.
- Experience with off-page SEO and link building, both active and passive.
- Experience with AI/LLM SEO optimization and building brand mentions through outreach.
- US market experience, having worked extensively with US clients or audiences, or having lived/studied in the US.
- Bachelor of Science degree, with preference for STEM fields such as Marketing Analytics, Statistics, Economics, or Data Science.
- Experience with SEO tools, including Ahrefs, Semrush, Moz, and Screaming Frog.
- Experience with email outreach tools such as BuzzStream, , Pitchbox, and Mailshake.
- Experience with data analysis tools, including Google Sheets, Excel, and Google Analytics.
- 1+ year of management experience.
- Advanced level of English.
Nice to have:
- Experience working in the IT industry.
- Experience in email outreach for SaaS companies.
- Experience in B2B markets.
- Digital PR experience.
- Copywriting background.
- Media relations experience.
- A/B testing and CRO experience.
- Editorial placements experience.
How we do make your work (and your life) easier:
- 100% remote work (from anywhere).
- Excellent compensation in USD or your local currency if preferred
- Hardware and software setup for you to work from home.
- Flexible hours: create your own schedule.
- Paid parental leaves, vacations, and national holidays.
- Innovative and multicultural work environment: collaborate and learn from the global Top 1% of talent.
- Supportive environment with mentorship, promotions, skill development, and diverse growth opportunities.
Apply now and become part of a global team where your unique talents can truly thrive

title: Senior Email Marketing Manager
description:
About Darkroom
Darkroom is the leading next-generation growth marketing firm engineering the brands of tomorrow. Founded in 2017, we set out to redefine what a modern agency could be, by replacing the inertia of legacy advertising behemoths with a model built for speed, intelligence, and measurable impact.
At our core, Darkroom is a human services company powered by Matter, a universal AI commerce layer that integrates executive-level strategy with proprietary agentic technology. This fusion enables our teams to deliver outsized returns by enhancing creative output, operational efficiency, and revenue generation across every stage of the customer journey.
Our track record speaks for itself: billions in attributable revenue driven across e-commerce marketplaces, media networks, DTC ecosystems, and social commerce platforms. Every engagement feeds into our proprietary data infrastructure, enabling a continuous feedback loop that accelerates growth, improves margins, and compounds results across our client portfolio.
What began as a boutique design studio has evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc and among the most effective performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos). Our founders were recognized by Forbes 30 Under 30 for advancing the intersection of technology, marketing, and advertising, cementing Darkroom's role as a defining player in the future of media innovation.
About The Role
We are hiring a Senior Manager, Retention—a seasoned CRM strategist and operator who brings equal parts creativity, technical depth, and leadership maturity to the table. This is not a maintenance role; it requires strategic ownership, hands-on execution, and a bias for measurable impact. You'll lead a team of lifecycle marketing experts to build sophisticated email, SMS, and loyalty programs that drive retention, increase LTV, and power sustained growth for a portfolio of fast-scaling e-commerce brands. This role demands sharp customer insight to turn data into strategy, comfort with complexity, and the ability to influence clients and internal stakeholders alike. You'll report to our Director of Retention and collaborate closely with Performance, Creative, and Strategy teams to deliver cohesive, cross-channel campaigns rooted in data and customer psychology.
Darkroom is a career accelerator for retention marketers who want to do the best work of their careers—operating at the intersection of personalization, loyalty, and performance-driven innovation.
This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Portugal, Mexico, Brazil, and Spain.
You Should Apply if this sounds like you:
You're passionate about e-commerce and digital marketing. You're immersed in the world of direct-to-consumer growth marketing. We're looking for an expert Senior Manager, Retention to join our team In this role, you will join a growing team within the Retention Marketing Department to strategically develop customized CRM and retention marketing strategies that help our clients grow and scale through email and SMS, subscription, and loyalty programs.
7+ years of work experience in digital marketing.
You immerse yourself in scaling personalized D2C/e-commerce email and SMS programs that build deep customer relationships for clients.
You can creatively message the value propositions of any brand's product catalog to create email and SMS campaigns that customers find to be engaging, informative, and persuasive.
You're passionate about developing creative customer journeys and loyalty programs that drive loyalty and lifetime value.
You have experience working in Klaviyo (or a similar ESP's) including list segmentation, lifecycle drip automations, and triggered events. Additionally, you have knowledge of Shopify and their tech stack options such as Privy, JustUno, Yotpo, Octane AI etc.
You have developed SMS and loyalty programming strategies and have experience working with SMS platforms such as Attentive, PostScript, SMSBump, or Klaviyo.
You're used to working in a fast paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.
You love making data driven decisions and excel at turning analytics into actionable SMS and email strategies that drive client revenue.
You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.
You have experience developing and executing customer loyalty programs that enhance LTV.
You've had at least one direct report before and exceptional leadership skills working with cross-functional teams.
Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.
A Day in the Life:
Serve as the senior point of contact for select clients, working to develop best-in-class retention strategies. On a weekly basis, you will meet with clients to discuss current and future initiatives.
Develop strategic campaign calendars and prioritize projects and initiatives designed to scale your clients' email and SMS programs.
Provide support and guidance to help Retention Specialists analyze data, develop winning retention strategies and create reports for clients happiness.
Project manage and delegate client tasks to your team, consisting of both specialists and designers. Review all client briefs and designs for approval before they are sent to the client.
Coordinate cross-departmentally with the Performance Marketing and Strategy teams to develop cohesive and creative campaigns that drive client growth.
Assign segmentation and QA email and SMS campaigns ensuring flawless delivery to customer audiences.
Report on strategic KPIs for clients, creating insights and actionable recommendations to grow client retention engagement and revenue.
Execute on automation/flow logic set-up, pop-up builds, and app integrations.
Working at Darkroom
Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.
We believe in autonomy with accountability, truth over comfort, and outcomes over optics. If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you'll thrive here.
Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. While many roles remain fully remote, employees hired to work from our New York or Lisbon HQs (opening early 2026) are expected to adopt a hybrid working model, including weekly in-office appearances. Hub locations also include the Bay Area, Philly, São Paulo, and Barcelona.
Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.
Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.
Equal Opportunity Statement
Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

title: Estágio em Migração de Banco de Dados
description:
Descrição da empresa
Quer trabalhar na maior plataforma de saúde do MUNDO?
Somos a Doctoralia, empresa do grupo Docplanner, e estamos presentes em 13 países, sendo responsáveis por atender mais de 55 milhões de pacientes e processar mais de 17 milhões de agendamentos de consultas por mês Atualmente, temos mais de 2 milhões de profissionais da saúde em nossa base, somando aproximadamente 14 milhões de avaliações de pacientes até hoje.
Nossa missão é "Ajudar as pessoas a viverem vidas mais longas e saudáveis".
Através de uma diversificada gama de serviços, conseguimos atender a diferentes públicos: marketplace, que permite que pacientes agendem e avaliem consultas e médicos a qualquer hora do dia ou da noite; e sistema SaaS (Software as a Service) voltado para otimização da gestão do consultório, fluxo de pacientes e realização de consultas online. Tudo isso através de plataforma na internet ou aplicativo para iOS ou Android.
Aqui na DOC, valorizamos e celebramos a diversidade em todas as suas formas. Estamos empenhados em atrair talentos diversos, sem importar gênero, raça, orientação sexual, religião, nacionalidade, idade ou condição física. Estamos comprometidos em construir uma equipe inclusiva e acolhedora, onde cada indivíduo possa fazer bonito, contribuindo com seu melhor.
Descrição da vaga
Como Pessoa Estagiária em Migração de Dados, você terá um papel importante no suporte às operações da empresa, atuando diretamente no processamento, organização e migração de dados de clientes para nossos sistemas, em um contexto SaaS.
Esta é uma excelente oportunidade para quem deseja aprender na prática, com exposição técnica real, contato com clientes e interação com times internacionais.
Qualificações
O que você vai fazer no dia a dia
Apoiar a migração de dados a partir de arquivos fornecidos pelos clientes, desde cenários mais simples até casos mais complexos, sempre com acompanhamento do time;
Auxiliar na análise, validação e organização de dados antes e depois da importação;
Dar suporte a clientes e times internos na resolução de dúvidas e problemas relacionados à importação de dados;
Identificar e reportar possíveis bugs ou inconsistências na ferramenta interna de importação, acompanhando a evolução das correções;
Apoiar a criação de soluções e automações simples (como scripts) para melhorar eficiência operacional e produtividade do time;
Contribuir para a documentação de processos, boas práticas e aprendizados;
Apoiar testes e validações de novas soluções, trazendo feedbacks para melhoria contínua;
Seguir boas práticas de segurança e confidencialidade de dados.
O que buscamos em você
Interesse em atuar com dados, tecnologia e análise;
Conhecimentos em SQL (nível intermediário);
Boa base em Excel;
Noções de lógica de programação (Python ou R são diferenciais);
Capacidade analítica e vontade de aprender a resolver problemas;
Boa comunicação, com interesse em interagir tanto com times técnicos quanto não técnicos;
Organização, senso de responsabilidade e gestão do tempo;
Inglês intermediário (leitura, escrita e conversação) para interação com times internacionais;
Estar cursando ensino superior ou curso técnico em áreas relacionadas a TI;
Disponibilidade para estagiar por um período estendido (idealmente até 2 anos).
Será um diferencial se você tiver:
Experiência prévia (acadêmica, estágio, projetos ou freelas) com dados;
Interesse ou vivência em ambientes SaaS e dinâmicos;
Curiosidade por automações e melhoria de processos.
Informações adicionais

title: Production Supervisor
description:
The Production Supervisor will support BW Energy's production operations on Brazilian offshore assets. This position is responsible for supervising daily production activities, ensuring safe and efficient operation of all process plant systems, and coordinating interfaces between operations, maintenance, logistics, and subsurface teams. The role also includes maintaining operational documentation, reporting performance, and ensuring compliance with Company and Client procedures.

Responsibilities
  • Supervise CRO, Production Operators and Laboratory Technician, ensuring clear understanding of roles and responsibilities.
  • Manage daily operation of the production plant, ensuring safe operation in accordance with BW/Client procedures.
  • Ensure accurate reporting and documentation in AMOS and other operational systems.
  • Maintain clear production history of each well and equipment;
  • Identify and report deficiencies, malfunctions, and non-conformities; propose corrective and improvement actions.
  • Prepare the plant for intrusive maintenance and ensure proper coordination with Maintenance and other departments.
  • Understand and apply Isolation Standards (LOTO) and contribute to risk assessments.
  • Manage and maintain operational documentation, including procedures and technical records.
  • Act as Permit to Work (PTW) system coordinator when appointed by the OIM.
  • Administer and monitor COSHH on the FPSO;
  • Interpret logged operational data and support decision-making during routine and abnormal operations.
  • Ensure proper shift handover practices, maintaining continuity of plant awareness.
  • Support daily interface between Engineering, Operations, Logistics, Subsurface, and Maintenance teams.
  • Contribute to KPI tracking, reporting, and production performance monitoring.
  • Support emergency response duties as assigned and maintain full readiness for abnormal situations.
  • Engage in continuous improvement, identifying unsafe conditions and ensuring corrective actions per procedures.
  • Maintain valid certifications and medical requirements relevant to offshore and job-specific duties.

Education

  • HNC (Higher National Certificate) in Chemical/Petrochemical field.
  • Engineering degree.
  • Solid and proven experience in production operations.
Experience
  • Experience in chemical/petrochemical industry with offshore operations.
  • Extensive experience in production departments.
  • Experience with FPSO operations and process plant systems (preferred).
  • Strong understanding of operational safety standards and PTW systems.

title: coordenador de contabilidade
description:
Buscamos um profissional para atuar como
COORDENADOR CONTÁBIL
em um provedor de serviços logísticos no Brasil e no Exterior.

Será responsável por liderar e organizar as atividades das áreas Contábil e Fiscal, garantindo o cumprimento de metas, prazos e conformidade com normas e legislações. Atuar na orientação técnica a clientes internos, coordenar auditorias externas e fiscalizações, conduzir o fechamento contábil e assegurar o compliance fiscal das empresas do grupo.

REQUISITOS

  • Formação Superior Completa em Ciências Contábeis com CRC ativo.
  • Desejável Pós Graduação em Controladoria / Finanças / Gestão Tributária.
  • Inglês intermediário, desejável avançado.
  • 5 anos de experiência profissional em empresas multinacionais e/ou nacionais.
  • Conhecimento de apuração de todos os tributos e entrega de obrigações acessórias munipais, estaduais e federais.
  • Experiência em planejamento tributário.
  • Experiência em revisão e elaboração de conciliação, análise de contas patrimoniais e resultado.
  • Experiência no preparo de demonstrações financeiras e caderno de auditoria, demonstrações financeiras base para publicação.
  • Conhecimento e aplicação das normas contábeis vigentes e revisão de demonstrações financeiras para a companhia de valores imobiliários.
  • Conhecimento e aplicação normas contábeis e IFRS.
  • Desejável conhecimento operacional módulo contábil: FI/CO - ERP SAP.
  • Desejável conhecimento em sistema fiscal (cockpit SAP).
  • Excel avançado.
  • Foco no cliente internos e apoio à boa gestão da empresa.

RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Atender amplamente a auditoria externa, analisando as solicitações, esclarecendo contabilizações, controlando cronogramas e demandas, garantindo que as demonstrações reproduzam fielmente a situação fiscal, contábil e financeira.
  • Desenvolver equipes fiscal e contábil promovendo a sinergia das áreas, visando a ampliação do conhecimento dos colaboradores.
  • Aprovar conciliações de todas as contas contábeis mantendo as principais em dia evitando divergências com auditoria externa ou não cumprimento das normas contábeis e fiscais vigentes.
  • Distribuir e implementar plano de ação carta de controles internos de auditoria externa, para redução ou mitigação dos pontos no próximo período.
  • Revisar e garantir a entrega de todas as obrigações junto aos orgãos Ferderais, Estaduais e municipais.
  • Aprovar e acompanhar as rotinas de encerramento de exercício e melhorias em sistemas, avançando em melhores práticas de controles fiscais e contábeis.
  • Prestar orientação contábil e fiscal para os clientes internos relativo ao caderno de auditoria, operações, legislação vigente ou demais situações técnicas para a correta aplicação e não exposição da empresa.
  • Transmitir as informações a usuários e órgãos reguladores,.
  • Aprovar lançamentos provenientes de reorganização societária para atendimento a normas vigentes.
  • Elaborar comentário sobre desempenho e relatório da diretoria nas demonstrações Financeiras auditadas;
  • Assegurar a entrega no prazo e correta de todas as obrigações acessórias nas diversas esferas tributárias, garantindo o compliance fiscal.
  • Assegurar que as operações fiscais da organização estejam ocorrendo em conformidade com a legislação fiscal corrente evitando autuações, multas e sanções.
  • Analisar e buscar o aproveitamento dos créditos tributários obtidos pela empresa, por meio de compensações, restituições ou transferência para outras unidades, contribuindo para a melhora no caixa e resultado.
  • Orientar e transmitir à equipe fiscal as mudanças ocorridas na legislação fiscal, por meio de instruções e informativos, garantindo que todos os colaboradores estejam atualizados.
  • Decidir com segurança e clareza sobre questões dúbias ou polêmicas referente a tributação, por meio de análise criteriosa da legislação vigente, buscando evitar os riscos de passivo.
  • Contribuir no adequado fechamento contábil, validando saldos contábeis a pagar e a recuperar de tributos.
  • Identificar oportunidades de redução na carga fiscal, discutindo interna e externamente sobre possibilidades decorrentes do nosso negócio ou posicionamento dos fiscos e tribunais.
  • Assegurar que todos os registros fiscais sejam efetuados dentro do período de competência, através da de controles das atividades e dos relatórios de apuração extraídos do sistema.
  • Coordenar o atendimento aos processos de fiscalização, auditorias internas e externa ocorridos na empresa.

title: Front-end Developer
description:
We are looking for the right people - people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world's largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Job Duties
We are building a platform that merges real-time physics, structured knowledge, and autonomous intelligence. We are looking for developers ready to tackle one (or more) of those challenges:

  • Complexity: Rendering massive tables and managing strict validation logic for mission-critical data pipelines.
  • Interactivity: Building conversational UIs (streaming chat) and high-performance time-series dashboards that update in real-time.
  • Visualization: Designing intuitive interfaces for Data Lineage, Knowledge Graphs, and Entity Mapping.

What You'll Do
You will join a high-performance team, ensuring design consistency across the platform while focusing on one of the following distinct tracks:

Core Responsibilities

  • Component Architecture: Create a reusable, strictly typed Angular component library that scales across AI, Dashboard, and Admin modules.
  • Performance: Optimize change detection strategies and virtual scrolling to ensure the UI remains responsive and performant, whether rendering a live data stream or a 3D object.
  • Data-Driven Design: Handle complex JSON schemas and heavy payloads, ensuring data precision from API to UI

Possible paths to work on the Project (you can contribute to one or more):

Data Platform & Management Tools

  • Build Management Interfaces: Develop the "Control Room" for Data Engineers, including Data Catalog and Pipeline Configuration screens.
  • Heuristics & Mapping: Create efficient workflows for "Entity Matching" that allow users to visually map raw sensor tags to physical assets.
  • Visualizing Lineage: Implement DAG visualizations or similar) to allow users to trace data asset layers and dependencies.

AI Interfaces & Visualization

  • Build AI Assistant UI: Develop rich conversational interfaces that support streaming responses (SSE), markdown rendering, and interactive "artifacts".
  • Advanced Dashboarding: Implement high-performance time-series charts using , ensuring smooth zooming/panning on large datasets.
  • Document Handling: Develop integrated viewers for PDF documents and rich media, allowing Agents to cite sources visually.

The Technology Stack
We use a modern, high-performance stack. You should be proficient in the Core and deeply knowledgeable in your chosen track.

  • Core Framework: Angular 16+ (Expert level), TypeScript, RxJS.
  • State Management: NgRx or Signals.
  • Visualization: (Time-series), (Lineage).
  • API Integration: REST APIs (FastAPI), Server-Sent Events (SSE), WebSockets (using )

Qualifications

  • Component Architect: You write clean, decoupled components and understand how to build a UI kit that scales.
  • UX Sensibility: You understand that a "Chat" interface needs to feel immediate and care about loading states and smooth transitions.
  • You take pride in building tools that make other engineers productive, caring deeply about workflow efficiency and keyboard shortcuts.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities
Must Haves:

  • 5+ years of experience in Frontend Development (Angular focus).
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript and reactive programming patterns.
  • Experience building Admin Dashboards, B2B SaaS interfaces, or complex SPAs.
  • Ability to handle complex API integrations and data modeling on the client side.
  • Advanced English communication skills

Good to Have:

  • Visualization: Hands-on experience with , , or Lineage/DAG graphs.
  • AI/Chat: Experience building Chat/LLM interfaces and handling streaming text.
  • Data Heavy: Familiarity with high-performance libraries and virtual scrolling.
  • Media/Geo: Experience with PDF rendering in-browser or Map/GIS libraries (Leaflet, Mapbox).

title: Partnership Business Development Executive
description:
ABOUT US
Chiliz - the world's leading sports-focused blockchain Tech company, is leading the charge into Web3, building a global ecosystem where fans don't just watch the game—they become a part of it. If you're ready to put on your jersey and get to work alongside a dynamic global team, this could be the perfect match.
OUR BRANDS
Chiliz: The backbone of our ecosystem, creator of Chiliz Chain - the Layer 1 blockchain that powers our vision of Web3 for sports and entertainment.
Fan Tokens: Official Digital Assets for more than 70 of the world's biggest sports teams, including giants like Paris Saint Germain, Man City, FC Barcelona.
The Web3 Fan Token Wallet and home of Fan Token rewards.
THE ROLE
We are looking for a self-starter with exceptional business acumen who can navigate complex stakeholder environments. You should be comfortable operating independently while collaborating across teams, possess strong analytical capabilities, and demonstrate genuine enthusiasm for the intersection of sports, technology, and finance. Your ability to identify creative partnership opportunities and execute them will be critical to success in this role.

Identify, evaluate, and develop strategic partnerships with retail networks, financial institutions, investment firms, and other potential distribution channels for fan tokens and Chiliz products
Build and maintain relationships with key decision-makers across banking, sports organizations, and crypto-related businesses in Brazil
Create compelling business proposals, pitch decks, and partnership frameworks tailored to prospective partners' needs and objectives
Conduct market analysis to identify emerging opportunities and competitive dynamics in the Brazilian digital asset and sports engagement landscape
Collaborate with internal teams to ensure successful partnership implementation and ongoing relationship management
Represent at industry events, conferences, and client meetings
Track partnership performance metrics and provide regular reports on business development activities and pipeline status

3+ years of experience in business development, sales, or partnerships, preferably within the financial services/banking sector. Preferably knowledge of web3, and could be sports related.
Proven track record of successfully closing complex B2B partnerships and achieving revenue targets
Strong understanding of the Brazilian financial services landscape and regulatory environment
Excellent presentation and negotiation skills with ability to influence C-level executives
Fluency in Portuguese and English (written and verbal)
Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or related field
Preferred Qualifications
Direct experience or demonstrated interest in sports industry partnerships and sponsorships
Knowledge of cryptocurrency, blockchain technology, and digital asset markets
Existing network within Brazilian banking, retail, or investment sectors
Experience drafting commercial agreements and partnership terms
What We Offer:
The chance to join a global community of sports blockchain enthusiasts spanning 6 countries and over 40 nationalities, committed to building a vibrant, exciting Web3 future for sports alongside some of the biggest names on the planet. We're looking for team players who are happy to try, fail, and bounce back—because a great team is all about the comeback.
We believe the interview process is a two-way street. Think of it as a draft where we're both trying to make the best pick. Our competitive salaries, wellness allowance, healthcare, and pension plans are just the tip of the iceberg. You'll be joining a diverse, global team, where flexibility and challenge are part of the playbook.
Ready to play? Let's get to work.

Fundada em 1977 como "Cardiolab", atualmente conta com 75 hospitais próprios e 3 sob gestão, além de 55 clínicas oncológicas, nos estados do RJ, SP, MG, PE, BA, MA, SE, CE, AL, PB, PR, MS, PA e DF.

Gerencia diferentes marcas, tendo presença mais marcante no Rio de Janeiro, com a marca "D'Or"; em SP, com "São Luiz"; em PE, com "Esperança"; no DF, com "Santa Luzia" e "Santa Helena"; no MA, com "UDI"; na BA, com "São Rafael"; em SE, com "São Lucas"; no PR, com "Santa Cruz"; em MG, com "Biocor", em MS, com "Proncor", em PB, com "Nossa Senhora das Neves", em CE com "São Carlos", além da marca premium "Star" nos estados do RJ, SP e DF.

Em 23 de dezembro de 2022, a proposta de valor da Rede D'Or foi reforçada significativamente com a consumação da combinação de negócios com a SulAmérica – a maior seguradora do Brasil e uma das maiores operadoras de saúde do país. Acreditamos na responsabilidade em contribuir para uma sociedade mais justa, inclusiva e com igualdade de oportunidades, por isso, todas as nossas vagas estão abertas a pessoas de diferentes perfis e contextos, inclusive pessoas com deficiência.

title: Marketing Program Manager
description:
About Cambly

Cambly is transforming how the world learns English. With millions of students across the globe and thousands of native English-speaking tutors, we've created a platform where real conversations lead to real fluency. We're not just another language app—we're building authentic human connections that break down barriers and open up opportunities.

As we expand, we're scaling our creative capabilities to match our global ambitions. This is where you come in.

About the Role

We're looking for a strategic, creative builder who can establish Cambly's voice in organic channels from the ground up—someone who sees the white space and knows how to own it. If you thrive on 0-to-1 challenges, love the intersection of content and growth, and want your work to directly impact millions of learners worldwide, this role is for you.

You'll own our SEO/AEO strategy and community presence, establishing sustainable channels that reduce our reliance on paid advertising while building trust and authority with professional English learners in Japan, Korea, and globally. This is a high-impact role where you'll create new programs, coordinate cross-functional teams, and directly influence Cambly's long-term growth trajectory.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute Cambly's SEO/AEO program to increase organic search visibility and ranking for high-intent keywords across markets in APAC, LATAM, and Europe, including localized blog strategy, influencer partnerships for backlinks, and technical SEO implementation in partnership with the Product team.

  • Develop global social media strategy with localized content approaches for different markets and platforms, including Instagram optimization and YouTube expansion plans.

  • Outline measurable goals and create monthly reports on how we are tracking against them.

  • Create content strategy centered on social proof: user testimonials, tutor spotlights, student success stories, and product education that drives conversion and builds community trust.

  • Build community management frameworks for global platforms (including Naver - Korea, among others), local review sites, and global social channels with culturally relevant messaging.

  • Manage SEO content agencies and coordinate with creative teams (designers, video editors, copywriters) to produce high-quality, on-brand content at scale.

  • Track, analyze, and report on SEO, social, and community performance metrics to measure impact, inform strategy iterations, and present insights to leadership.

  • Partner with Growth, Product, and Marketing teams to align content strategy with business goals while monitoring competitive landscape and platform trends in target markets.

Requirements (Must-Haves)

  • 5+ years of experience in SEO, content strategy, or digital marketing with proven track record of building and scaling organic channels

  • Demonstrated expertise in SEO/AEO strategy, including technical SEO, content optimization, and link-building programs

  • Strong understanding of social media platforms, algorithms, and content strategies across multiple channels (Instagram, YouTube, TikTok, etc.)

  • Experience developing and executing content strategies that drive measurable business results (traffic, engagement, conversion)

  • Experience managing agencies, freelancers, or content teams to produce high-quality work at scale

  • Proficiency with analytics tools (Google Analytics, SEMrush, Ahrefs, or similar) and ability to translate data into actionable insights

  • Excellent project management skills with ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously

  • Native in Portugese and excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with international or APAC markets, particularly Japan and Korea

  • Familiarity with AI tools for content optimization and SEO research

  • Experience in language learning, education technology, or subscription businesses

  • Knowledge of video content strategy for YouTube, Instagram Reels, and TikTok

  • Background managing influencer content programs or creator partnerships

description:

  • Graduação completa em em Ciências Contábeis, com CRC ativo;

  • Conhecimentos de Leis que regem o Terceiro Setor;
  • Conhecimento comprovado dos princípios, práticas e padrões contábeis.

Será um diferencial se você tiver:
